name: Unmaker, Endweaver
body:
UNMAKER, ENDWEAVER
CR 17

XP 102,400
CE Large outsider (native, psionic, unmaker)
Init +10; Senses all-around vision, aura sight, darkvision 120 ft., lifesense 120 ft.; Perception +20; Aura nullified miracles (60 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 22, flat-footed 22 (+7 deflection, +6 Dex, +6 natural, –1 size)
hp 178 (17d10+85); regeneration 10
Fort +15, Ref +11, Will +17
Defensive Abilities all-around vision, blank slate, ruinous shield; DR 10/-; Immune cold; PR 28
Weaknesses unstable resolve

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft., fly 80 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 claws +23 (2d6+7 force damage plus energy drain), 5 tendrils +21 (1d6+3 force damage plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (20 ft. with tendrils)
Special Attacks energy drain (2 levels, DC 25), space-rending blows
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 17th; concentration +24)

Constant—aura sight, pierce the veils, reddopsi, slip the bonds
At will—dispel psionics*, energy missile (17d6–17 force, DC 26), extradimensional waymaking*, greater psychoport, planar travel, wrench
3/day—ad nihilo*, banish (DC 23), ectoplasmic shambler, psychomachy ego whip (DC 24, 4d4), sever the strand
1/day—apopsi (DC 26), psionic effigy (may target all within 60 ft.), unravel psionics (DC 26) (powers do not include the +2 DC bonus from Greater Psionic Endowment)

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 23, Con 20, Int 24, Wis 25, Cha 24
Base Atk +17; CMB +25 (+29 grapple); CMD 48
Feats Combat Reflexes, Greater Psionic Endowment, Greater Sunder, Improved Initiative, Improved Sunder, Metapsionic Ability (ego whip, Psychomachy), Multiattack, Power Attack, Psionic Endowment Skills Bluff +27, Diplomacy +27, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (arcana) +27, Knowledge (history) +27, Knowledge (planes) +27, Knowledge (psionics) +27, Knowledge (religion) +27, Perception +27, Sense Motive +27, Spellcraft +27, Stealth +20, Survival +27
Languages telepathy 300 ft., truespeech
SQ no breath, ruinous power, spacial rapture

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Nullified Miracles (Su)

Whenever a creature other than the endweaver attempts to cast a spell or manifest a power within 60 feet of the endweaver, they must succeed at a concentration check (DC 20+the level of the spell or power) or lose the effect.

Blank Slate (Ex)

Any divination or clairsentience effects that would attempt to perceive or gather information on an endweaver automatically fail. The creature and any info on it simply do not show up.

Spatial Rapture (Su)

The endweaver’s planar mastery enables it to keep creatures close and nullify any ability for them to escape while also impairing the approach of others. Any attempt to teleport, plane shift, or summon a creature into a location inside the endweaver’s aura of nullified miracles automatically fails. In addition, any creature that would try to leave an endweaver’s aura of nullified miracles through movement, teleportation, or any other means must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude save or else be hedged in by the effect, unable to move beyond the reaches of the aura. This does not stop the endweaver from moving away from creatures on its own accord and leaving them outside the area.

ABOUT

Endweavers are designed to combat powerful spellcasters and psionicists, matching their versatility and power with a bevy of entrapping and negating abilities. They are schemers and strategists, often taking time to figure out the abilities of their opponents.
